subject: Pre-forecast pipeline sanity & account depth check — HelioHealth (HL-8421)
body:
From: rachel.kim@redwood.com
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, naomi.feldman@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, Ellie Martinez <ellie.martinez@heliohealth.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pre-forecast pipeline sanity & account depth check — HelioHealth (HL-8421)

Team / Ellie —

We’re kicking off a quick pre-forecast sweep for HelioHealth ahead of the finance check-in on Wednesday. Objective here: verify stage-level coverage, confirm any true-commit accounts, and capture next-step timing so finance can map run-rate scenarios.

Quick asks (can you reply inline):
- Ben/laura: please update SFDC stage and ARR fields by EOD (I highlighted the accounts in the attached snapshot).
- Naomi: capture the most likely close month (Oct/Nov/Dec) and whether procurement has signaled any blockers.
- Ellie / Procurement: can you confirm the expected PO timing and whether the MA redlines we submitted are OK?

Attached: helio_pipeline_snapshot_Q4.xlsx (stage-level rollup) and a draft mutual action plan (helio_MA_plan_v2.pdf).

Short rhythm here — I’ll consolidate and send a one-slide summary to finance at 3pm PT.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Sr. Sales Finance Partner
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Ellie Martinez <ellie.martinez@heliohealth.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@heliohealth.com
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 10:01:05 -0400
Subject: Re: Pre-forecast pipeline sanity & account depth check — HelioHealth (HL-8421)

Thanks Rachel — appreciate the heads up.

Quick answers: we routed the legal redlines to procurement and they should respond by EOD tomorrow (they asked for a final MA v2 which you attached). PO timing: procurement expects a PO by 11/05 if legal signs off this week. No technical blockers on our side; implementation kickoff is on track pending contract.

I can hop on a 15-min sync if helpful.

Best,
Ellie Martinez
Director, Platform Integrations
HelioHealth

-----Original Message-----
From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com, naomi.feldman@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Ellie Martinez <ellie.martinez@heliohealth.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:07:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-forecast pipeline sanity & account depth check — HelioHealth (HL-8421)

On it — I went through the snapshot and updated the opportunity stages for the Helio accounts:
- HelioHealth Core (HL-8421-Core): moved to Final Negotiation (was Contract Review). Commit = $420k; expected close 2026-11-05 (aligned with PO).
- HelioHealth Analytics (HL-8421-ADX): staying in Commit Review; lower probability, $120k, target Dec.

I left notes on the snapshot about the single outstanding pricing ask from their SRE team (token discount for initial 3 months) — flagged as a negotiation point for SLA/credit.

Ben
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, rachel.kim@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 12:45:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-forecast pipeline sanity & account depth check — HelioHealth (HL-8421)

Thanks Ben — confirming the close months:
- HL-8421-Core: 2026-11-05 (Firm if legal signs this week)
- HL-8421-ADX: 2026-12-15 (Upside)

Laura — can you validate that the ARR math in the snapshot matches SFDC? I flagged a difference of $10k in the Analytics line.

I also attached a quick mutual-action extract in the spreadsheet (tab: MAP_summary) that finance asked for — please double-check before I send to them.

-naomi
Sr. Rev Ops Analyst | Redwood Inference

Attachment: helio_pipeline_snapshot_Q4.xlsx (updated: MAP_summary tab)

-----Original Message-----
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, rachel.kim@redwood.com, Ellie Martinez <ellie.martinez@heliohealth.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-forecast pipeline sanity & account depth check — HelioHealth (HL-8421)

All — I reconciled the ARR in SFDC with the snapshot and corrected the Analytics line to match Opportunity HL-8421-ADX (now reads $130k — note moved from $120k after adjustment). I also attached the redline log in case finance wants audit notes.

Next steps (per finance cadence):
- Naomi will push the MAP_summary tab to finance by 15:30 PT.
- Ben to confirm if pricing credit is acceptable or whether we need an executive escal for the token credit ask.
- Ellie / Procurement to confirm PO timing (11/05 target) or alert if that slips.

Sending one-slide summary in 10 mins.

Laura Bennett
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments in thread:
- helio_pipeline_snapshot_Q4.xlsx (snapshot, updated)
- helio_MA_plan_v2.pdf (MA draft)
- helio_redline_log.txt (audit notes)
